actual_exec_tool.actual_result: Retain real tools.exec_command return object, exact submitted command/source/VIEW, result.output strictUTF8 bytes, exit_code integer where present; session/missing completion cannot qualify.
actual_exec_tool.rendered_outer: Only exact rendered items/truncation observations are available; no hidden envelope byte identity
actual_exec_tool.scope: Observable byte availability and same-cursor retry progress under explicit trusted tool-runtime forwarding; no hidden outer-envelope identity or LLM consumption

equality_result.cases: cases[].label/status; requirement union exact original44+new11; grouped binding label retains improved semantics. case control may use synthetic Env and legitimately have zero actual processes; all real compiler/kernel cases bind actual processes and artifacts.
equality_result.execution_binding: Fresh sidecar records installed source hash/current closure root, registered harness path/hash, actual process receipt, raw results.json hash; candidate-root development reports inadmissible.
equality_result.private_result_format: No format key currently emitted; status DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_RELEVANT_REGRESSIONS
equality_result.top_status: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY or DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_RELEVANT_REGRESSIONS is provenance, never a whole-root PASS. Do not invent generic controls/requirements keys.

fresh_author.messages: Literal candidate agent_message and sole own newly unrelated carrier only. Exact exposed drafts/FINAL retained; no resampling.

phase_receipt.output_identities: Additional current launcher sidecar outputs map authenticates all semantic reports/artifacts; original receipt alone does not bind report paths.
phase_receipt.pid: positive actual PID exposed by direct subprocess launcher only
phase_receipt.returncode: integer excluding bool; exact registered accepted value
phase_receipt.streams: path/sha256/byte_count of actual direct-process separate log bytes

suite_result.rule: Exact final ordered starts and one PASS per final registered test; every adverse count zero; complete maps/root guards equal.
